case.text: Temperature alarm, it stops after about half an hour
case.expected_root_cause: Oil cooler fins blocked with dust, reducing cooling.

titles: High discharge temperature alarm (E101) due to blocked oil cooler fins (high; model high, evidence medium)
High temperature alarm in summer due to insufficient compressor room ventilation (medium; model medium, evidence medium)
High discharge temperature alarm with cold oil cooler (low; model low, evidence medium)

case.text: الكمبروسر بيطفي لحاله بعد نص ساعة وبيطلع انذار حرارة
case.expected_root_cause: Oil cooler fins blocked with dust, reducing cooling.

titles: High discharge temperature alarm (E101) due to blocked oil cooler fins (medium; model high, evidence low)
High temperature alarm in summer due to insufficient compressor room ventilation (low; model medium, evidence low)
Oil leak from loose hose fitting on RS-37 compressor (low; model low, evidence low)

case.text: High temp alarm and the oil sight glass is almost empty
case.expected_root_cause: Low oil level in the separator tank.

titles: Low oil level causing high temperature alarm E101 (high; model high, evidence medium)
Oil leak from loose hose fitting on RS-37 compressor (medium; model medium, evidence medium)
High discharge temperature alarm (E101) due to blocked oil cooler fins (low; model low, evidence medium)

case.text: Overheating within 10 minutes of start, the cooler is cold when I touch it
case.expected_root_cause: Thermostatic (thermal bypass) valve stuck closed, oil bypasses the cooler.

titles: High discharge temperature alarm with cold oil cooler (medium; model high, evidence low)
Cooling fan stopped / fan motor overload (low; model medium, evidence low)
High discharge temperature alarm (E101) due to blocked oil cooler fins (low; model low, evidence low)

case.text: Cooling fan is not spinning
case.expected_root_cause: Cooling fan motor failed or its overload relay tripped.

titles: Cooling fan stopped / fan motor overload (high; model high, evidence high)

case.text: Air delivery is low and pressure takes long to build up
case.expected_root_cause: Air intake filter element clogged.

titles: Clogged air intake filter (E210) (high; model high, evidence medium)

case.text: انذار فرق ضغط السبريتر والامبير عالي
case.expected_root_cause: Oil separator element clogged (end of service life).

titles: Separator differential pressure high (E220) (high; model high, evidence high)

case.text: Production says there is oil coming out of the air tools, we are adding oil every week
case.expected_root_cause: Scavenge line orifice or strainer blocked, oil collects in the separator and carries over.

titles: Oil carryover into air lines from blocked scavenge line orifice/strainer (medium; model high, evidence low)
Oil leak from loose hose fitting on RS-37 compressor (low; model low, evidence low)

case.text: Compressor is running, motor on, but the pressure never goes up. No alarm.
case.expected_root_cause: Inlet (intake) valve stuck closed or its diaphragm torn.

titles: Intake valve stuck - compressor runs but does not load (high; model high, evidence medium)
Inlet valve diaphragm torn - compressor runs but does not load (high; model high, evidence medium)
Loading solenoid connector loose - compressor never loads (low; model low, evidence low)

case.text: It stays in unload mode
case.expected_root_cause: Loading solenoid valve coil burnt or connector loose.

titles: E410 loading solenoid coil burnt - compressor stays unloaded (high; model high, evidence medium)
Loading solenoid connector loose - compressor never loads (medium; model medium, evidence medium)

case.text: Machine running loaded non stop and still the plant pressure is low, you can hear air hissing near line 2
case.expected_root_cause: Air leaks in the distribution pipework, fittings or tools exceed compressor capacity.

titles: Air leak causing low plant pressure (high; model high, evidence medium)

case.text: Display shows pressure 25 bar then 0 then 14, jumping around
case.expected_root_cause: Pressure transducer failed or cable damaged.

titles: E501 Pressure Transducer Faulty (high; model high, evidence medium)

case.text: won't start, temperature shows -99
case.expected_root_cause: Discharge temperature sensor (PT1000) open circuit or connector corroded.

titles: E502 Temperature Sensor Fault - Corroded Sensor Connector (RS-55) (high; model high, evidence high)

case.text: Main motor tripped on overload, it's a very hot day
case.expected_root_cause: Main motor overload relay tripped due to high current (low supply voltage or high discharge pressure setting).

titles: Motor overload trip due to low supply voltage (E301) on hot days (high; model high, evidence high)
High temperature alarm in summer due to insufficient compressor room ventilation (low; model low, evidence low)

case.text: After the electricity maintenance yesterday the compressor won't start, phase alarm
case.expected_root_cause: Phase loss or wrong phase sequence on the incoming supply (blown fuse or supply work).

titles: Phase alarm due to blown L2 fuse (high; model high, evidence high)

case.text: Alarm E001 and I cannot reset it
case.expected_root_cause: Emergency stop button pressed, or its contact block faulty.

titles: Emergency stop alarm due to faulty contact block (high; model high, evidence medium)

case.text: صوت صفير قوي وقت التشغيل والهوا قليل
case.expected_root_cause: Drive belts worn or tension too low (belt-driven RS-37).

titles: Belt squealing on RS-37 drive belts (medium; model high, evidence low)
Clogged air intake filter (E210) (low; model medium, evidence low)
Air leak causing low plant pressure (low; model low, evidence low)

case.text: Rumbling noise from the electric motor and a lot of vibration
case.expected_root_cause: Main motor bearing worn or lacking grease.

titles: Motor hot and noisy bearings (RS-55) - main motor bearing worn or lacking grease (high; model high, evidence medium)
Main motor grinding noise and vibration (RS-37) (medium; model medium, evidence medium)
Cooling fan stopped / fan motor overload (low; model low, evidence low)

case.text: Water in the air lines at the packing machines, the auto drain never opens
case.expected_root_cause: Electronic condensate drain valve blocked or its timer/strainer faulty.

titles: Water in compressed air lines due to blocked condensate drain valve (high; model high, evidence medium)
Condensate drain strainer blocked (low; model medium, evidence low)

case.text: When I restart it right after stopping, it fails to start
case.expected_root_cause: Blowdown (vent) valve not venting the sump at stop, so the motor restarts against pressure.

titles: Blowdown control line cracked causing start trip (high; model high, evidence medium)

case.text: Contactors clicking and chattering during start, motor stalls
case.expected_root_cause: Worn star-delta contactor or faulty transition timer.

titles: Star-delta contactor chattering at start due to incorrect timer setting and worn contactor (high; model high, evidence high)
E303 Star-Delta Transition Fault - Pitted Delta Contactor (medium; model medium, evidence high)

case.text: There is oil on the floor under the compressor
case.expected_root_cause: Oil leak from a hose, fitting or the oil filter gasket.

case.text: Service due message, oil looks very dark
case.expected_root_cause: Service interval exceeded; oil degraded and oil filter clogged.

titles: Service Overdue with High Temperature (E601) (high; model high, evidence high)

case.text: Dew point alarm and water in the lines
case.expected_root_cause: Dryer condenser dirty or dryer drain blocked (RS-55 integrated dryer).

titles: Dryer high dew point alarm (E701) (high; model high, evidence high)
Dryer high dew point due to dirty condenser (RS-55) - E701 (high; model high, evidence high)
Condensate drain strainer blocked (medium; model medium, evidence medium)

case.text: Compressor loads and unloads every few seconds
case.expected_root_cause: Pressure band too narrow or air receiver too small for the demand pattern.

titles: Short cycling due to narrow load/unload pressure band (RS-37) - resolved by widening band to 1.0 bar (high; model high, evidence medium)

Airend is seized, the motor hums but the screw won't turn even by hand
